name: Echoes of Time
detailed_description:
"Echoes of Times" is a narrative independent game developed based on RPG Maker MV, focusing on free exploration and character interaction. Players will play the role of a protagonist lost in a world of time and space. By exploring the map, talking to different NPCs and completing exclusive tasks, they will gradually uncover the truth hidden in the "Echoes of Time".

This game adopts a free exploration advancement method, and the player's choice will affect the direction and ending of the story. In the process of solving puzzles and advancing tasks, you will face a deep discussion about memory, fate and choice.

Whether you like plot exploration, logical reasoning, or a casual player with light challenges, "Echoes of Times" can bring you a relaxing and thoughtful game journey.

Game Features:

Free exploration gameplay: No linear advancement is required, players can freely shuttle between multiple areas to unlock hidden content and side stories.

Minimalist art style and immersive sound effects: The elegant visual style and soothing background music that match the atmosphere of the story create a unique emotional experience.

Story structure with variable endings: Player behavior will determine the final direction of the game, bringing high replay value.

Lightweight experience suitable for all players: no high operation threshold, more emphasis on emotional resonance and narrative immersion.
